result.title: Decision Boundaries Matter: Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation for Cross-Domain Fake Image Detection
result.summary: Despite learning transferable features, fake image detectors may struggle on unseen domains due to mismatched decision boundaries. Our analysis shows that features extracted by the frozen forensic encoder remain discriminative, but the source-trained decision boundary does not fully exploit this information. However, correcting this boundary without source data or target labels remains challenging, as unreliable source predictions may lead to incorrect adaptation. To address this issue, we propose Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation (GraRA), which refines the source decision boundary using only unlabeled target data. To determine which classifier directions to update, GraRA constructs a compact residual subspace from uncertainty-weighted target features and keeps it orthogonal to the source classification direction. To guide these updates, it uses source-score anchors to generate soft labels through target-graph diffusion, while neighborhood consistency regularizes residual learning within the constrained subspace. The learned correction is merged into the source classifier, requiring only 32 optimized coefficients and no additional inference branches. On diverse unseen OpenMMSec domains, GraRA achieves 84.36\% accuracy and 91.34\% AUC, improving over the source detector by 4.33 and 3.50 percentage points, respectively. Further analysis shows that reliable source predictions and locally consistent neighborhoods help guide residual learning, allowing GraRA to correct ranking errors that a simple threshold shift cannot address. \textcolor{cvprblue}{Code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GraRA，在冻结的取证编码器上用无标签目标域数据修正源域决策边界：以不确定度加权的目标特征构造与源分类方向正交的紧凑残差子空间，并用 target-graph diffusion 生成的软标签与邻域一致性约束残差学习，仅优化 32 个系数且不增加推理分支，用于跨域伪造图像检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结骨干＋受约束的低维读出修正」线索可供核查 LVR 中收益究竟来自内部视觉状态还是仅决策层/读出适配，邻域一致性软标签也可能供核查 latent 轨迹的筛选与无标签监督；但该文不研究视觉推理状态生成，与主线仅间接相关。
